purpose: Compare saved core-topic legacy, Korean and English index observations without treating missing verdicts or canonicals as changes.

policy.source: Existing private snapshots only; preserve observation dates and PT performance windows.
policy.grouping: Ten registered topics, each with English/Korean/legacy identity validation.
policy.deployment: Use actual timezone-aware deployment completion time, not merge time; post-deployment crawl is not proof of causality or indexing completion.
policy.unknown: Missing verdicts are uncomparable, missing canonical fields are not canonical changes, missing performance rows are not zero.
policy.privacy: No query data in the report; optional exclusive mode-600 output outside all registered worktrees.

validation.offlinePrivateBaseline: generated without API calls; no private metrics committed

limits: No new Google observations or indexing requests in this change.
No production deployment of this report feature.
